summary_text: In March 2026, the user ordered Fortune Sugar 1 kg on two independent dates (2026-03-17 and 2026-03-31), both on weekdays in the afternoon. This repetition establishes a stable preference for the Fortune brand in the Sugar category. The afternoon timing aligns with the population afternoon share (0.2526) but is less common than the population morning share (0.3246). No other sugar brands or variants were observed this month.

stable_preference_claims.claim_text: The user has a stable preference for Fortune sugar, evidenced by orders on two independent dates in March 2026.

uncertainty_text: This analysis is based on two orders in March 2026. While the brand preference is stable within this month, the sample size is limited to a single month.
